changelog: New voice command: say 'star point' (or 'তারা পয়েন্ট' / 'স্টার পয়েন্ট') alone while dictating and a new line with a star ★ starts — for star-bulleted offer/feature lists ('offers star point cash on delivery star point home delivery' → offers ★ cash on delivery ★ home delivery, each on its own line) instead of typing every ★ by hand. Works even with Spoken Punctuation off; with it on, 'star point' also works mid-sentence. The bullet, numbered and checkbox lists work exactly as before. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
